---
title: "Stargazer rendering issue"
format: html
---

# Default chunk — HTML output is NOT rendered (issue)

```{r}
library(stargazer)
fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
stargazer(fit, type = "html")
```

# With results: asis — workaround

```{r}
#| results: asis
stargazer(fit, type = "html")
```

# Text type — also affected without asis

```{r}
stargazer(fit, type = "text")
```
